features: Allows new competitors to be registered with an unassigned blank bib number
Applies optional bib registration to Scoring Tests, real Manual Scoring and real Automatic Scoring through the shared registration hook
New competitors still receive a real official BDC ID immediately even when no bib has been distributed
Bib uniqueness is enforced only when a real bib number is assigned
Blank bib is stored as NULL rather than zero to avoid confusing Registration Desk and scoring staff
Existing database schema already supports nullable scoring-entry bib numbers, so no database migration is required
Bib can be assigned or changed later through the established bib update workflow
No scoring calculation, tiering, special-category points or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
